findings.title: Clock /SWCLK on outer layer
findings.description: Clock net /SWCLK is 100% routed on outer layers (microstrip). Inner stripline layers provide better shielding from radiation.
findings.recommendation: Route clock signals on inner layers (stripline) when possible.
findings.summary: Clock /SWCLK on outer layer

findings.title: Clock /SWCLK routed near connector J3
findings.description: Clock net /SWCLK passes within 9.5mm of connector J3. Clock harmonics can couple to attached cables via proximity, increasing radiated emissions.
findings.recommendation: Route /SWCLK away from J3, or add ground guard traces between the clock and connector.
findings.summary: Clock /SWCLK routed near connector J3

findings.title: Board cavity resonance frequencies
findings.description: Board (40×38mm, εr=4.4) cavity resonances: (1,0) at 1787 MHz; (0,1) at 1881 MHz; (1,1) at 2594 MHz. PDN impedance spikes at these frequencies. Ensure adequate decoupling at and around these frequencies.
findings.recommendation: Add decoupling capacitors with SRF near these frequencies.
findings.summary: Board cavity resonance frequencies

findings.title: Missing stitching via at layer transition: /BAT_SENSE
findings.description: Net /BAT_SENSE has 8 layer transition(s) across B.Cu, F.Cu. 8 transition(s) have no ground stitching via within 1.0mm. The return current must find an alternate path, creating a loop antenna.
findings.recommendation: Add a ground stitching via within 1.0mm of each signal via. Place the ground via adjacent to the signal via on the same pad cluster.
findings.summary: Missing stitching via at layer transition: /BAT_SENSE

findings.title: Single ground via near ESD device D2
findings.description: D2 (esd_ic) has 1 ground via within 3mm. Multiple parallel vias reduce ground inductance. Two vias halve the inductance (~0.5nH → ~0.25nH).
findings.recommendation: Add a second ground via near D2 for lower inductance.
findings.summary: Single ground via near ESD device D2
